query: 道德采购政策 道德采购政策 衡量企业在采购决策中集成反贿赂、公平贸易、人权保障及环境约束的治理水平。重点考察道德采购标准的系统性、供应商准入尽调、采购团队及供应商培训以及违规问责机制。 一、内容质量得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（卓越）：具备独立的《道德采购政策》，明确将人权、环境、反贿赂指标纳入供应商准入及考核的“一票否决制”；具备完善的第三方尽职调查流程；设有定期的采购伦理培训；且具备透明的违规处理与社会责任绩效反馈机制。 • 1分（合格）：在采购管理制度中包含道德与环保条款，具备基础的合规审查和廉洁声明，有违约处罚规定，但缺乏跨维度的责任采购标准或系统化的尽调、培训闭环。 • 0分（不合格）：无相关道德采购政策披露，或仅有简单的“成本优先”采购描述。 二、覆盖应用得分 (权重 50%，取值：0, 1, 2) • 2分（高覆盖）：道德采购准则覆盖 >80% 的年度采购总额或关键类别供应商，且披露了通过 ESG 准入审核的供应商占比。 • 1分（部分覆盖）：占比 >0% - 80%，或仅针对生产类原材料执行，而忽略了服务性采购或非核心供应商，或未说明覆盖比例。 • 0分（无覆盖）：无相关覆盖范围信息。 道德采购 负责任采购 公平贸易 采购尽调 一票否决 采购伦理培训 冲突矿产 本地化采购 EcoVadis ethical procurement responsible sourcing fair trade supplier due diligence procurement veto buyer ethics training conflict minerals local procurement EcoVadis 是否有独立《道德采购政策》或等效制度？ 人权、环境、反贿赂是否纳入准入/考核并可一票否决？ 供应商尽调如何开展？ 采购团队与供应商伦理培训如何安排？ 违规问责与社会责任绩效反馈机制是什么？
instruction: Assess whether the passage provides concrete evidence for the ESG indicator '道德采购政策'. Prefer explicit, auditable disclosure that answers: 是否有独立《道德采购政策》或等效制度？ 人权、环境、反贿赂是否纳入准入/考核并可一票否决？ 供应商尽调如何开展？ 采购团队与供应商伦理培训如何安排？ 违规问责与社会责任绩效反馈机制是什么？ Exclude or down-rank: 排除：仅有成本或交付率导向的采购；仅有供应商环境标准、廉洁协议或行为准则单点而无采购准入、考核或否决应用；仅有本地化采购、冲突矿产或公平贸易单一专题而无跨维度采购治理。区分：道德采购把人权、环境、反贿赂等要求集成进采购决策、尽调、考核和问责；单一专题只能作为组成证据。 Preserve relevant tables, notes, units, limitations, policies, targets, methods and coverage details.

[Content]
The major suppliers of the Group are terminal machinery, components, oils and lubricants suppliers and ferry owners. Under the principles of 'transparency, fairness, impartiality and honesty', the Group has established a comprehensive tendering evaluation system and set up stringent supplier screening procedures in the Management Measures for Tendering and Bidding and the Procedures of Procurement Management, regulating the management of different types of suppliers of the Group. A total of 234 suppliers were covered in the evaluation during the Reporting Period. The Group's Technical Support Department works closely together with relevant departments to identify suitable suppliers and to assess their qualifications and performance. At least three potential suppliers would be invited for tendering for the Group to choose the right suppliers.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.

The Group has been trying to incorporate the sustainable practice into its supply chain management. We seek to work with suppliers who share the same value with us. Apart from evaluating the cost, reputation and delivery of potential suppliers' products and services, the Group also considers their social and environmental performances, such as product and service quality, ethical conduct and environmental conservation. Taking Sun Ferry as an example, Sun Ferry has stipulated its ESG requirements for suppliers in a Supplier Code of Conduct , and favours suppliers who could demonstrate commitments to uphold sustainability principles listed in the code during suppliers' selection process.

results.section: Quality and Reliable Service / Valuing Customer Privacy and Persistence in Information Accuracy
results.text: Every year, we evaluate the performance of our existing suppliers according to the criteria and procedures specified in the Regulations Governing Integrated Supplier Evaluation to ensure suppliers are aligned with our requirements. results.section: People-oriented Workplace / Merit-based Remuneration and Promotion
results.text: The Group strictly follows labour laws and regulations in areas where it operates and prohibits any form of child labour or forced labour. To prevent forced labour, the Group properly regulates employees' working hours and rest periods. We would never force employees to work against their wills with violence or intimidation, or by restricting their freedom. To avoid child labour, the Group requires candidates to provide proof of identity and candidates without a valid identity proof would not be considered. In case of child labour and forced labour are discovered, the Group will take immediately actions to stop such from happening.

Environmental Protection / Employing Electrical Machinery

[Content]
The major contributors to the Group's carbon footprint are fuel consumption of machinery, vehicles, ferries and vessels and electricity consumption from the operation of offices and cargo and passenger terminals. The total amount of GHG emissions was 71,394.34 tCO 2 e, Scope 1 and Scope 2 GHG emissions were approximately 63,356.95 tCO 2 e and 8,037.39 tCO 2 e respectively. Therefore, the Group strives to reduce our fuel and electricity consumption in order to cut down the associated GHG emissions.
